name: Tsukiyama Misaki
source:
Born on June 16, 1989. Gemini. Blood type is AB. Member of the Art Club. Her hobby is emailing.
She has long hair that is tied on one side. She has a bright and cheerful personality, but on the other hand, because of her naivety, she is easily tricked and often speaks up out of the blue. His innocent actions often make those around him amazed. Other students are amazed by her innocent personality. She has never been able to score double digits on a test, and she often refers to herself as "stupid" and "the 5-point girl." Despite being aware of her poor grades, she still hasn't improved them, so she is taking remedial classes with her math teacher, Takamine.
She is friendly with everyone, but she is especially close to her childhood friend Hiyama Taiyo, and she often exchanges emails with him when Taiyo is absent from school. She walks to school with Taiyo whenever he attends, and even tries to give him her hand-knitted gloves, showing that she really likes him.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]

Makes a special appearance in the PSP release of [I][url=/v5080]Kamaitachi no Yoru 2 ~Kangokujima no Warabe Uta~[/url][/I] as a part-time maid.
